goal: DEPTH: sub-sections / config sections in real integration with the backend — raise real coverage and capability levels

depth_targets.title: Default encryption
limitations: Stored and returned exactly as configured; objects are not encrypted at rest and responses do not carry x-amz-server-side-encryption yet.

depth_targets.title: Block public access (bucket settings)
limitations: Stored and returned; public bucket policies and ACLs are not rejected yet, and Vyomi does not authenticate requests, so anonymous access is not modelled.

depth_targets.title: Bucket policy
limitations: Stored and returned; the policy is not evaluated for authorization.

depth_targets.title: Lifecycle rules
limitations: Rules are stored and returned; expiration and transitions are not applied yet.

depth_targets.title: Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS)
limitations: Stored and returned; CORS headers are not applied to browser requests yet.

depth_targets.title: Object Ownership
limitations: Stored and returned; object ownership is not enforced.

depth_targets.title: Access control list (ACL)
limitations: Bucket and object ACLs are stored and returned (Get/PutBucketAcl, Get/PutObjectAcl); grants are not evaluated for authorization.

depth_targets.title: Event notifications
limitations: Offline appliance: events are delivered to the configured SQS queues, SNS topics and Lambda functions in this simulator (ObjectCreated, ObjectRemoved, DeleteMarkerCreated, TestEvent).
Nano: the configuration is stored and returned, but events are not delivered yet.

note:
